meta.name: Tarot Cards
meta.subtitle: Major Arcana & Minor Arcana — Rider-Waite tradition

items.name: The Fool
items.keywords: Beginnings, innocence, spontaneity, free spirit
items.fact: A young man steps off a cliff, bindle over shoulder, gazing at the sky. A white dog nips at his heels. He is about to step into the void — naively, joyfully. The start of the Fool's journey through all the Major Arcana.
items.mnemonic: THE FOOL: Mr Bean on a cliff edge, not looking where he's going, a little dog barking warnings he ignores. He's all potential, no experience.

items.name: The Magician
items.keywords: Willpower, skill, manifestation, resourcefulness
items.fact: One hand points to heaven, one to earth. On the table: all four suit symbols (cup, wand, sword, pentacle). He channels divine will into earthly action. As above, so below.
items.mnemonic: THE MAGICIAN: Derren Brown with all four elements on his table, one hand pointing up at God, one pointing down at the world. Everything he needs is in front of him.

items.name: The High Priestess
items.keywords: Intuition, mystery, the subconscious, inner knowledge
items.fact: A serene woman sits between two pillars (B and J — Boaz and Jachin, from Solomon's Temple), a crescent moon at her feet, a scroll in her lap. She guards the veil between the conscious and unconscious.
items.mnemonic: HIGH PRIESTESS: A mysterious librarian between two pillars, refusing to show you the scroll in her lap. 'The answers are within.' She is infuriating and correct.

items.name: The Empress
items.keywords: Fertility, nature, abundance, motherhood, creativity
items.fact: A ripe, pregnant woman sits in a lush natural setting, wheat at her feet, a crown of stars. She is nature, abundance, creative fertility. Venus rules her.
items.mnemonic: THE EMPRESS: A heavily pregnant woman sitting in a wheat field, surrounded by fruit, wearing a crown. She is earth mother. Everything is growing. Nature is thriving.

items.name: The Emperor
items.keywords: Authority, structure, control, fatherhood, stability
items.fact: An older man sits on a stone throne decorated with rams' heads, holding an ankh sceptre. He is order, authority, the father. The mountains behind him are rigid and unchanging.
items.mnemonic: THE EMPEROR: King Charles on a rigid stone throne covered in rams. Everything is organised and controlled. He is the structure that makes civilisation possible.

items.name: The Hierophant
items.keywords: Tradition, institutions, spiritual authority, conformity
items.fact: A religious figure, like a pope, sits between two pillars, two acolytes kneeling before him. He represents established religion, tradition, conventional wisdom, institutional authority.
items.mnemonic: THE HIEROPHANT: The Pope delivering a sermon to two kneeling believers. 'Do it the traditional way.' He is institutions, inherited wisdom, the rulebook.

items.name: The Lovers
items.keywords: Love, union, choices, alignment of values, relationships
items.fact: Adam and Eve beneath an angel (Raphael). The Tree of Knowledge is present. This is not just romance — it's about choices, duality, and alignment of values. Often signifies a major decision.
items.mnemonic: THE LOVERS: Adam and Eve under the angel, the apple tree nearby. It's romantic but it's really about choice — and choices have consequences.

items.name: The Chariot
items.keywords: Control, willpower, victory, assertion, determination
items.fact: A warrior drives a chariot pulled by two sphinxes — one black, one white. He holds no reins; he controls them by willpower alone. He has conquered opposing forces through discipline.
items.mnemonic: THE CHARIOT: A driver with no reins, controlling a black sphinx and a white sphinx by pure force of will. Victory through discipline. He's absolutely winning.

items.name: Strength
items.keywords: Inner strength, courage, patience, compassion, control
items.fact: A woman gently opens the jaws of a lion, an infinity symbol above her head. This is not physical strength but inner fortitude — controlling the beast through gentleness rather than force.
items.mnemonic: STRENGTH: A serene woman opening a lion's mouth with her bare hands, an infinity symbol floating above her. She is stronger than the lion because she is calm.

items.name: The Hermit
items.keywords: Soul-searching, introspection, solitude, guidance, inner wisdom
items.fact: An old man stands alone on a mountain peak in the snow, holding a lantern and a staff. He has withdrawn from the world to find inner wisdom. He doesn't escape from the world — he goes inward to find light to share.
items.mnemonic: THE HERMIT: Gandalf/Merlin alone on a snowy mountain, holding a lantern. He's not lonely — he's seeking. Then he'll come back and share the light.

items.name: Wheel of Fortune
items.keywords: Good luck, karma, cycles, destiny, turning points
items.fact: A great wheel turns, creatures rising and falling with it. The Hebrew letters on the wheel spell YHWH; the alchemical symbols represent the four elements. The sphinx sits atop — wisdom transcends the wheel.
items.mnemonic: WHEEL OF FORTUNE: The Wheel of Fortune game show but with souls rising and falling on it. The wheel just turns — you ride up, you ride down. The sphinx sits above it, unaffected.

items.name: Justice
items.keywords: Fairness, truth, cause and effect, law, accountability
items.fact: A figure sits between pillars holding scales in one hand and a raised sword in the other. Clear-eyed, impartial justice. Cause and effect. You reap what you sow.
items.mnemonic: JUSTICE: Lady Justice, unblindfolded, weighing your actions with perfect scales, sword ready. You cannot fool her. Cause and effect have a face.

items.name: The Hanged Man
items.keywords: Suspension, letting go, new perspectives, sacrifice, waiting
items.fact: A man hangs upside-down from a tree by one foot, expression serene, a halo around his head. He is not suffering — he chose this. Suspension brings revelation. A different perspective reveals hidden truths.
items.mnemonic: HANGED MAN: A man hanging upside-down from a tree, looking completely chill, glowing. He's voluntarily hung himself there to see the world differently. It's working.

items.name: Death
items.keywords: Endings, transformation, transition, change, letting go
items.fact: A skeletal knight on a white horse. A king lies dead; a bishop pleads; a child holds flowers. The sun rises between two towers in the background. Death rarely means literal death — it means transformation, an ending that allows new beginnings.
items.mnemonic: DEATH: The Grim Reaper on a white horse. Kings, bishops, children — no exceptions. BUT the sun is rising behind him. This is transformation, not annihilation.

items.name: Temperance
items.keywords: Balance, moderation, patience, purpose, meaning
items.fact: An angel pours water between two cups, one foot on land, one in the water. A path leads to a crown in the mountains. Temperance is the art of mixing, balancing, finding the middle path — alchemy in daily life.
items.mnemonic: TEMPERANCE: An angel mixing drinks between two cups with impossible skill. One foot in water, one on land. The art of balance. Do not overdo anything.

items.name: The Devil
items.keywords: Shadow self, addiction, bondage, materialism, ignorance
items.fact: Baphomet-like figure on a pedestal, two humans chained below him — but the chains are loose; they could remove them. This card is about self-imposed bondage: addiction, materialism, feeling trapped by forces that are actually within your control.
items.mnemonic: THE DEVIL: The addictions and obsessions that chain you — but look closely: the chains are loose. You could leave. You're choosing not to.

items.name: The Tower
items.keywords: Sudden change, upheaval, chaos, revelation, awakening
items.fact: A tower is struck by lightning, its crown blown off, figures falling from windows into the void. The structure was built on a false foundation — the lightning is a correction. Sudden, catastrophic, necessary change.
items.mnemonic: THE TOWER: Lightning hitting a skyscraper and blowing the top off while people fall out. Everything you built on a false foundation gets demolished. Terrifying. Necessary.

items.name: The Star
items.keywords: Hope, faith, renewal, inspiration, serenity
items.fact: A woman kneels by a pool, pouring water onto land and back into the pool. Eight stars shine above — one large, seven small. After the chaos of the Tower, the Star is pure hope and renewal. The waters nourish the earth; there is plenty.
items.mnemonic: THE STAR: After the tower collapses, a beautiful woman pours water under the stars. Everything is going to be okay. Hope has arrived. The world is being refreshed.

items.name: The Moon
items.keywords: Illusion, fear, the unconscious, confusion, dreams
items.fact: A full moon shines between two towers, a crayfish emerging from a pool, a dog and a wolf howling. The path is unclear; things are not as they seem. The unconscious, dreams, illusions, the strange territory between waking and sleep.
items.mnemonic: THE MOON: A path at night between two towers, a crab crawling out of a pond, a dog and wolf both howling at the moon. Something strange is happening. Trust nothing entirely.

items.name: The Sun
items.keywords: Joy, success, vitality, confidence, happiness
items.fact: A joyful naked child rides a white horse in front of a brilliant sun. Sunflowers bloom behind a wall. This is pure, uncomplicated happiness — vitality, confidence, success, the joy of being alive.
items.mnemonic: THE SUN: A naked, laughing child galloping on a white horse under a massive, beaming sun. Pure joy. Nothing complicated. Just radiant happiness.

items.name: Judgement
items.keywords: Reflection, reckoning, awakening, absolution, inner calling
items.fact: An angel blows a trumpet; the dead rise from coffins to be judged. This is not death but rebirth — a final reckoning that leads to transformation. Hearing a call and responding to it fully.
items.mnemonic: JUDGEMENT: Gabriel blowing his trumpet, the dead rising from coffins — not to be condemned but to be reborn. A call has gone out. Answer it.

items.name: The World
items.keywords: Completion, integration, accomplishment, wholeness, travel
items.fact: A dancing figure at the centre of a laurel wreath, surrounded by the four fixed signs of the zodiac (bull, lion, eagle, angel). The Fool's journey is complete. All things are integrated. This is wholeness.
items.mnemonic: THE WORLD: A dancer at the centre of everything, surrounded by the four corners of the universe, wrapped in a laurel wreath. The journey is complete. Everything is in its right place.

items.name: ⚡ The Minor Arcana — Four Suits
items.fact: The 56 Minor Arcana cards are divided into four suits, each associated with an element and a domain of life. WANDS (Fire) — creativity, ambition, passion, career. CUPS (Water) — emotions, relationships, intuition, dreams. SWORDS (Air) — intellect, conflict, truth, challenges. PENTACLES/COINS (Earth) — material world, money, body, work. Each suit has Ace through 10, plus four Court Cards: Page, Knight, Queen, King.
items.mnemonic: WANDS = fire/career. CUPS = water/emotions. SWORDS = air/conflict. PENTACLES = earth/money. Court cards: Page (student), Knight (action), Queen (mastery inward), King (mastery outward).

items.name: Ace of Wands
items.keywords: Inspiration, new beginnings, growth, potential
items.fact: A hand emerges from a cloud holding a budding wand. Pure creative potential — the seed of a new enterprise, creative spark, beginning of a journey.
items.mnemonic: ACE OF WANDS: A hand holding a magic wand that's actually sprouting leaves. Pure creative energy, ready to go.

items.name: Two of Wands
items.keywords: Planning, future vision, progress, decisions
items.fact: A figure stands on a castle battlement, holding a wand and a globe, looking out at the horizon. Plans are being made. The vision exists; now the journey must begin.
items.mnemonic: TWO OF WANDS: A man on a tower holding the whole world in his hand, planning his next move. The vision is big. The departure is imminent.

items.name: Three of Wands
items.keywords: Expansion, foresight, overseas opportunities, awaiting results
items.fact: A figure watches ships sail away across the sea. Three wands are planted in the ground. Plans have been set in motion and ventures launched — now we wait for them to return with wealth.
items.mnemonic: THREE OF WANDS: A merchant watching his ships sail to distant lands. He's already taken the leap — now he waits confidently for returns.

items.name: Four of Wands
items.keywords: Celebration, joy, harmony, home, community
items.fact: Two figures dance under a floral canopy supported by four decorated wands. A castle stands behind. This is the card of a celebration — a wedding, homecoming, harvest festival.
items.mnemonic: FOUR OF WANDS: A maypole party. Garlands, dancing, a welcoming castle. Come home; celebrate what you've built.

items.name: Five of Wands
items.keywords: Conflict, competition, disagreement, tension, diversity
items.fact: Five young men brandish wands at each other. They don't seem to be causing harm — this is more like competitive sparring, rivalry, debate. Creative friction rather than destructive conflict.
items.mnemonic: FIVE OF WANDS: Five lads hitting each other with sticks. Loud, chaotic, but nobody's really getting hurt. It's competitive rather than vicious.

items.name: Six of Wands
items.keywords: Victory, success, public recognition, progress
items.fact: A crowned figure rides a white horse in triumph, holding a laurel-wreathed wand. A crowd cheers. Hard-won public success and recognition.
items.mnemonic: SIX OF WANDS: A victory parade. The hero rides through the crowd on a white horse, wreath on head. You won. People noticed.

items.name: Seven of Wands
items.keywords: Challenge, perseverance, defending position, determination
items.fact: A figure stands on a hill, defending against six wands thrusting up at him from below. He has the high ground but is under pressure. Defending a position you've earned from those who want to displace you.
items.mnemonic: SEVEN OF WANDS: Standing on a hill fending off six attackers with a stick. You got there first; now hold your ground.

items.name: Eight of Wands
items.keywords: Speed, action, air travel, movement, rapid development
items.fact: Eight wands fly through the air above a peaceful landscape. There are no figures — pure motion. Things are happening fast. Messages, movement, rapid developments.
items.mnemonic: EIGHT OF WANDS: Eight spears flying through the air at high speed. Everything is moving. Emails are arriving. Flights are booked. Speed.

items.name: Nine of Wands
items.keywords: Resilience, persistence, last stand, boundaries, courage
items.fact: A wounded man leans on a wand, eight others behind him. He's been through a lot — head bandaged — but he's still standing, still defending. The last reserves of resilience.
items.mnemonic: NINE OF WANDS: A battered soldier leaning on his spear, holding the line. Absolutely knackered. Absolutely not giving up.

items.name: Ten of Wands
items.keywords: Burden, extra responsibility, hard work, completion, overcommitment
items.fact: A figure struggles forward carrying ten heavy wands, a town in the distance. The goal is in sight but the burden is immense. Carrying too much, yet almost there.
items.mnemonic: TEN OF WANDS: A person bent double carrying ten spears, nearly home. They've taken on too much. The destination is visible. Nearly there.

items.name: Page of Wands
items.keywords: Enthusiasm, exploration, discovery, free spirit, news
items.fact: A young person stands in a desert, holding a budding wand and looking at it with curiosity. Full of enthusiasm and ideas, but inexperienced. The start of a creative adventure.
items.mnemonic: PAGE OF WANDS: An excited student discovering their creative passion for the first time. Full of ideas. No idea what to do with them yet.

items.name: Knight of Wands
items.keywords: Action, adventure, fearlessness, energy, impulsive
items.fact: A knight on a rearing horse, salamanders on his tunic, charging forward into the unknown. Passionate, bold, action-oriented — but can be reckless and scattered.
items.mnemonic: KNIGHT OF WANDS: A young man on a galloping horse, absolutely certain of his direction, probably wrong. Passionate, reckless, irresistible energy.

items.name: Queen of Wands
items.keywords: Courage, confidence, determination, independence, social butterfly
items.fact: A queen sits on a sunflower-decorated throne, a wand in one hand, a sunflower in the other, a black cat at her feet. She is confident, charismatic, independent, energetic. The natural leader.
items.mnemonic: QUEEN OF WANDS: A charismatic woman on a sunflower throne with a black cat, exuding total confidence. Everyone wants to follow her. She's brilliant at parties and boardrooms.

items.name: King of Wands
items.keywords: Natural born leader, vision, entrepreneur, honour
items.fact: A king sits on a lion-decorated throne, a small salamander near his feet. He is the visionary leader — bold, decisive, innovative, inspiring. Natural born entrepreneur.
items.mnemonic: KING OF WANDS: The CEO who started the company in his garage, now on a throne. Visionary, bold, inspiring. Occasionally difficult to work for.
